topic: Differences between a department and branch

questions.q: Which of the following statements highlights the main operational difference between a **department** and a **branch**?
options: A department operates in geographically distant towns, while branches operate strictly under one roof
Departments are divisions operating within the same physical premises, whereas branches are established in geographically separated locations
Departments prepare independent balance sheets, while branches never account for assets
Departments engage exclusively in manufacturing, whereas branches engage solely in retail trading
questions.explain: The fundamental difference lies in physical location: **departments** are sections or divisions situated under the same roof or within the same business premises (e.g., shoe department and clothing department in a department store), whereas **branches** are geographically separated units operating at different physical locations away from the Head Office.
